newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Average rate 4.09 pct on Swedish 7 day T-bill.
newsitem.headline: Average rate 4.09 pct on Swedish 7 day T-bill.

text.p: Sweden's National Debt Office said on Tuesday the average rate in a seven day Treasury bill auction was 4.09 percent.
The office issued a total of 10 billion crowns of the seven day paper.
The lowest accepted rate was 4.07 percent, while the highest accepted rate was 4.10 percent, the office said. 10.43 percent of the bids were served at the highest rate.
The T-bill runs from January 15 to January 22.
